title: An Introductory Primer & Grammar of Ahom (Tai) Language
author: Prof. J. N. Phukan & François Jacquesson (CNRS / Brahmaputra Project)
genre: Tai Ahom Philology, Pedagogical Grammar & Buranji Epigraphy
description: Comprehensive 18-lesson philological primer and reference grammar of the Tai Ahom language prepared by Prof. J. N. Phukan of Gauhati University and edited by François Jacquesson at CNRS Paris using Stephen Morey's font, providing systematic explanations of Ahom script, phonology, ligatures, parts of speech, and historical Buranji vocabulary.

sentences.speaker: Prof. J. N. Phukan
